newsitem.title: USA: Sachem CSD, N.Y., $44 mln notes won by three firms.
newsitem.headline: Sachem CSD, N.Y., $44 mln notes won by three firms.

text.p: Three firms split Sachem Central School District, N.Y.'s $44 million tax anticipation note deal, market sources said Tuesday.
First Albany Corp. won $10 million at a net interest cost of 3.93 percent and another $10 million at a 3.90 percent NIC.
Fleet Securities won $15 million at a 3.84 percent NIC and another $5 million at 3.94 percent.
Chase Securities won $4 million at 3.82 percent.
All the notes carry a 4.50 percent coupon.
